summary: GLM-5.3 (744B) serves the losslessly compressed NVFP4-CSF checkpoint: 7.8% more KV cache at TP8
compatibility: Opt-in: --quantization nvfp4_csf --load-format nvfp4_csf with local-inference-lab/GLM-5.3-NVFP4-CSF. Other checkpoints are unchanged.
details: The NVFP4-CSF reader knows the 744B expert family (layers 3-77 under model.layers) and accepts the glm_moe_dsa model type.
A single-recipe NVFP4 source quantizes exactly the modules that store weight scales, so the BF16 MTP layer 78 loads unquantized from the same checkpoint.

TP8 MTP3 on 8x RTX PRO 6000: KV cache 576,896 tokens vs 535,040 with the original checkpoint; decode steps/s -5.5% at C1, -2% at C2, -4% at C4 while B12X rebuilds the compressed scales in every pipeline stage; prefill within 3%.
